title: MOTION (PRICE - HUTT) relative to amending Council Action of March 13, 2026 (C.F. 26-0159).
text:
[Council File 26-0159; CD 9]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (PRICE - HUTT) relative to amending Council Action of March 13, 2026 (C.F. 26-0159).
Recommendation for Council action:
AMEND the Council Action of March 13, 2026 (C.F. 26-0159) relative to designating the intersection of 23ʳᵈ Street and Central Avenue as "Lincoln Theater Square" to designate the intersection of 23ʳᵈ Street and Central Avenue as "Quincy Jones Lincoln Theater Square."
